reply_text:
I sent you the list in our DM. I found three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers:

1. #4409, from Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard, at Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron during the 06:00 flatbed intake.
2. #4412, from the same Moss digest. It's a small glitch in the driver text-message prompt when combine trailers are parked on unpaved overflow lots.
3. PD-5302, from #central-random. Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as "one more ticket number for Marrow Fieldworks… for a follow-up from this week."

One thing to check: the digest doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks on #4409 and #4412 themselves. They're listed under the Fieldworks handoff item as tickets on "Pree's dealer account," so I counted them as Fieldworks.

Ticket #8841 might be related, but I can't confirm it. Tobias mentioned it in #central-random on 13 Oct about Door 2 in the west yard getting double-booked when flatbeds check in early at the Plains depots. Hollis's question that led to it called it "Tobias's dealer account," and nobody said Marrow Fieldworks.

I left out PD-4821 and FR-882 because they're Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. I also left out #88412, #4419 and PD-4492, which belong to other accounts. Moss's notes and this week's messages in your channels had no other Fieldworks ticket numbers.
